name: Assessment agent
role: Reads what each regional org has built on top of standard Salesforce (read-only), matches every custom component to a business capability, and proposes a fit-gap verdict: adopt standard, replace with configuration, retain, harmonise, retire, or review with the client, and a fitment code per capability and org. Each org is assessed in its own context; cross-org patterns are insights, not a consolidation plan.
inputs: Salesforce orgs listed in src/agents/assessment/engagement.json (one CLI alias per org, read-only integration user)
src/agents/assessment/capabilities.json (capability catalogue with the standard feature for each)
implementation: src/generators/assess-org.js (once per org; reads each Apex class and trigger function by function with src/generators/apex-functions.js)
outputs: adlc/1-discover/assessment/discovery-report.md (one Discovery Report for all orgs: executive summary, findings with risk and priority, landscape, data model, fit-gap, roadmap, appendix per org)
adlc/1-discover/assessment/discovery/ (complete discovery per org as data, behind the report and the Discovery explorer)
adlc/1-discover/assessment/orgs/ (as-is per org: components, counts, fill rates, markets; no record contents)

adlc/1-discover/assessment/fit-gap.json (every component with capability and verdict, cross-org matrix, and the function-level fit-gap of the Apex code: business functions with verdict and confidence, effort, regression and value, quick wins, cross-cutting findings, order of execution)
adlc/1-discover/assessment/architecture.md (principles, how the assessment runs, verdict flow, target direction)
done_when: Every connected org extracted, every custom component classified with a verdict and a reason, report and architecture written
reviewer_checks: Every org in the engagement is extracted, or its absence is explained
Markets found match the market list agreed with the client
Adopt-standard verdicts name a feature the client is licensed for, or the licence is on the workshop agenda
Retire candidates are confirmed unused with the business owner
Review items are on the workshop agenda
